types.label: Landing / sales page
types.description: Web page copy built around a single conversion goal: headline, subhead, benefit sections, social proof, CTA — includes long-form sales pages

types.label: Marketing email
types.description: Email to a list or segment: subject-line-driven, scannable, single primary CTA (newsletters, promos, nurture sequences)

types.label: Blog post / article
types.description: Long-form editorial or thought-leadership content meant to inform, rank, or build authority

types.label: Social media post
types.description: Short-form organic post for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, etc. — hook-first, platform-native, conversational

types.label: Ad copy
types.description: Paid placement copy with hard length limits: search ads (Google/Bing) or social ads (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok) — headline + description variants

types.label: Short-form video script
types.description: Script for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts — spoken-word copy, hook in the first seconds, written to be heard not read

types.label: Press release
types.description: Announcement in journalistic format: dateline, inverted pyramid, quotes, boilerplate

types.label: Case study
types.description: Customer story with problem → solution → results structure, usually with metrics

types.label: General marketing copy
types.description: Marketing writing that doesn't fit the other categories
